title: Hangman word game
when: The user wants hangman: guess a hidden word letter by letter before running out of misses.
prompt:
Goal: A word game with an on screen and physical keyboard, accent aware matching and an accessible drawing.
Steps:
1. Words by category in a local array; pick with injectable random; fold accents with normalize("NFD") for matching.
2. logic.mjs: guess(state, letter) ignores repeats, masked(word, guessed) like "_ A _ _", status playing, won or lost after 6 misses.
3. 26 letter buttons, disabled after use, plus physical keys.
4. SVG figure revealing parts by miss count, role="img" with a title like "3 of 6 misses".
5. Masked word and hit or miss feedback in aria-live; a Hint costs one miss.
6. End: reveal the word, Play again; wins and streak in localStorage guarded.
7. test.mjs: repeats, win, loss at 6, accents.
Quality bar:
- Category shown as a clue.
- Letter keys at least 44 px.
- Spaces and hyphens in phrases are shown, not guessed.
Pitfalls:
- Repeated letters counting as misses.
- Accented words impossible to finish.
- Drawing with no text alternative.
Verify:
- [ ] SVG has a title.
- [ ] Status live.
- [ ] Rules tested.
- [ ] node test.mjs passes.
Output: index.html, style.css, app.js, logic.mjs (rules), words.js, test.mjs.

examples.input: jogo da forca com palavras de frutas
examples.output: category Frutas, "_ A _ A _ A", letter keyboard, 6 misses
